title: What is National Night Out?
description:
The City of Los Angeles and the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) bring residents, officers and City officials together for National Night Out. Held annually on the first Tuesday in August, this nationwide event provides a relaxed setting for Angelenos to meet local LAPD officers and connect with their neighbors.

See how National Night Out builds trust, strengthens relationships and helps create safer, more connected Los Angeles communities.
